item.title: Plans Unveiled For Community Events Arena in Market Harborough
item.description: Plans have been unveiled to transform part of Welland Park in Market Harborough into a new community events arena. item.title: Harborough MP Backs Social Media Ban for Under-16s
item.description: Harborough’s Conservative MP Neil O’Brien is supporting calls to ban social media for children under 16. item.description: The enquiry office at Market Harborough Police Station will open for longer each day from next month.
